resolutions.researcher_notes: Mubasher.info (2019-04-23, Cairo): 'قالت شركة أنابيب البترول أنه تم ضخ استثمارات بالصعيد...' — Petroleum Pipelines Company chairman Abdel Moneim Hafez (رئيس شركة أنابيب البترول، عبد المنعم حافظ) states the company completed the 305km 'رأس غارب - أسيوط' (Ras Ghareb-Asyut) butagas pipeline as part of EGP 3.6bn Upper Egypt investment. Directly names Petroleum Pipelines Co as operator/builder of this exact line. Single agreeing source found (the youm7 seed citation covers the separate, parallel Ras Bakr-Ras Gharb-Asyut duplication line, P7364, not this one) -> tier medium, independent=false.
